descriptors.concept_name: Globalization Impact and Base Erosion Drivers
descriptors.definition: Global economic integration and digital advancements enable multinational enterprises to shift productive activities and exploit legal gaps across jurisdictions. These operational shifts facilitate aggressive tax planning structures that artificially erode domestic corporate tax bases.
inclusion: Cross-border movement of capital and labor
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from historical double taxation issues by focusing on profit disappearance through legal mismatch exploitation rather than mere overlapping tax jurisdictions.

descriptors.definition: The OECD BEPS action plan encompasses fifteen specific actions structured across three fundamental pillars to counter corporate tax avoidance. These pillars aim to introduce domestic rule coherence, reinforce economic substance standards, and enhance international transparency and tax certainty.
inclusion: Transfer pricing alignment with value creation
nearby_distinctions: Differs from general tax evasion by addressing sophisticated legal arbitrage and structural gaps in international tax rules rather than illegal non-compliance.
